def practice_pool_clause(guided=False):
    """Use the same approved, markable pool for availability and selection."""
    live = guided_live_question_clause('q') if guided else live_question_clause('q')
    types = ','.join("'" + name + "'" for name in sorted(LIVE_MARKABLE_TYPES))
    return (f"{live} AND scoremax_question_type(q.ph_response_contract,q.qtype,"
            f"q.answer_config,q.marking_config) IN ({types})")


PRACTICE_LEVEL_RANK_SQL = 'scoremax_mastery_rank(q.level)'
PRACTICE_ACCESS_SQL = PRACTICE_LEVEL_RANK_SQL + '<=?'


def practice_empty_message(c, clauses, params, ceiling, level, type_sql, type_args):
    """Classify an empty selection against the same scope before optional filters."""
    ranks = [mastery_rank(ceiling)]
    match_format = type_sql or '1'
    active, accessible, same_format, selected_level = c.execute(
        f"""SELECT COUNT(*),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN {PRACTICE_ACCESS_SQL} THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN {PRACTICE_ACCESS_SQL} AND ({match_format}) THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN {PRACTICE_ACCESS_SQL} AND ({match_format}) AND (?='' OR q.level=?) THEN 1 END)
        FROM questions q WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}""",
        ranks + ranks + type_args + ranks + type_args + [level, level] + params,
    ).fetchone()
    if not active:
        return 'This selection is not yet populated with active practice questions.', ''
    if not accessible:
        return (f'Active questions in this selection are above your {ceiling} access ceiling. '
                'They require access to a higher level.'), ''
    if not same_format:
        return (f'No questions in this format are available with your current access. '
                'Choose All available formats to see accessible alternatives.'), 'question_type'
    if level and not selected_level:
        return (f'No {level} questions match this selection. '
                f'Choose Mixed within my Access to find {same_format} accessible questions.'), 'level'
    return 'A practice set could not be built from these selections. Change your selections and try again.', ''

            subject_state=commercial_access.subject_state(
                conn,student_id,_TRACK_PROGRAMMES[track],subject,available=bool(scope_counts),
                commercial_gates_enabled=COMMERCIAL_GATES_ENABLED)
        finally:
            conn.close()
        cards=[];used=set()
        def card(scope,item):
            available=bool(scope and scope['count'])
            count=scope['count'] if scope else 0
            accessible=scope['accessible_count'] if scope and subject_state=='INCLUDED' else 0
            guided_only=available and not scope['scored_count']
            url=''
            status='Not yet populated'
            note='Questions will appear after a governed release is activated.'
            if available:
                status=f"{count} active · {accessible} accessible"
                if guided_only:
                    status+=' · guided practice, no score'
                elif scope['guided_count']:
                    status+=f" · {scope['guided_count']} guided"
                if subject_state=='LOCKED':
                    note='This subject is outside your current access package.'
                    url=url_for('access_account',locked_subject=subject)
                else:
                    note=f'Practise with your current {ceiling} access.' if accessible else (
                        f'Active questions require access above {ceiling}.')
                    url=(url_for('test_setup',subject=subject,chapter=scope['chapter'],scope='chapter',
                                 response_mode='GUIDED_SELF_ASSESSMENT') if guided_only and accessible
                         else url_for('chapter_page',subject=subject,chapter=scope['chapter']))
            return {'number':scope['number'] or item['number'] if scope else item['number'],
              'name':scope['name'] if scope else item['name'],'available':available,'status':status,
              'note':note,
              'url':url,'ph_release_chapter_id':scope['scope_ids'][0] if scope else ''}
        for item in items:
            scope=_catalogue_item_scope(scope_counts,item)
            if scope:used.add(scope['chapter'])
            cards.append(card(scope,item))
